description: Source code for cf2ft.c, a FreeType component that interfaces with Adobe's interpreter for font rendering, including functions for glyph transformation, outline handling, and font metrics.

classes.name: CF2_Outline
classes.description: Structure representing font outline, with callback functions for outline operations.

methods.name: cf2_checkTransform
methods.description: Checks if the transformation matrix is within acceptable scale limits for glyph rendering.

methods.name: cf2_setGlyphWidth
methods.description: Sets the glyph width in the outline based on the fixed width value.

methods.name: cf2_free_instance
methods.description: Cleans up font instance data.

methods.name: cf2_builder_moveTo
methods.description: Handles move-to operation in outline drawing.

methods.name: cf2_builder_lineTo
methods.description: Handles line-to operation in outline drawing.

methods.name: cf2_builder_cubeTo
methods.description: Handles cubic Bezier curve operation in outline drawing.

methods.name: cf2_outline_init
methods.description: Initializes outline structure with callback functions.

methods.name: cf2_getScaleAndHintFlag
methods.description: Retrieves scaling factors and hinting flags from glyph slot.

methods.name: cf2_getUnitsPerEm
methods.description: Retrieves units per em from font face.

methods.name: cf2_decoder_parse_charstrings
methods.description: Main function to parse and render a glyph's charstring data.

methods.name: cf2_getSubfont
methods.description: Returns current subfont based on glyph ID.

methods.name: cf2_getPpemY
methods.description: Gets the vertical pixels per em from font size metrics.

methods.name: cf2_getStdVW
methods.description: Gets standard vertical stem width for current subfont.

methods.name: cf2_getStdHW
methods.description: Gets standard horizontal stem width for current subfont.

methods.name: cf2_getBlueMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves blue zone metrics for font rendering.

methods.name: cf2_getBlueValues
methods.description: Retrieves blue zone values array and count.

methods.name: cf2_getOtherBlues
methods.description: Retrieves other blue zone values array and count.

methods.name: cf2_getFamilyBlues
methods.description: Retrieves family blue zone values array and count.

methods.name: cf2_getFamilyOtherBlues
methods.description: Retrieves family other blue zone values array and count.

methods.name: cf2_getLanguageGroup
methods.description: Retrieves language group identifier for current subfont.

methods.name: cf2_initGlobalRegionBuffer
methods.description: Initializes buffer for global subroutine region.

methods.name: cf2_getSeacComponent
methods.description: Retrieves component glyph data for SEAC composite characters.

methods.name: cf2_freeSeacComponent
methods.description: Frees glyph data buffer for SEAC component.

methods.name: cf2_initLocalRegionBuffer
methods.description: Initializes buffer for local subroutine region.

methods.name: cf2_getDefaultWidthX
methods.description: Retrieves default width for glyphs.

methods.name: cf2_getNominalWidthX
methods.description: Retrieves nominal width for glyphs.

methods.name: cf2_outline_reset
methods.description: Resets outline state for new glyph.

methods.name: cf2_outline_close
methods.description: Closes current outline contour.
